name: phylax
description: Opt-in Claude Code hooks: refuse attribution lines in commits and PRs, refuse staging COMMITS.md, warn on commits in a main checkout, refuse a subagent call that would silently inherit the session's model, restart idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code, and route work to cheaper models while the usage allowance burns too fast.

block_attribution_trailers.title: Block attribution lines in commits and PRs
block_attribution_trailers.description: Refuse git commit and gh pr create/edit/merge when the message or body carries a Claude-Session link, a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer, or a Generated with Claude Code line.

block_commits_md.title: Block staging COMMITS.md
block_commits_md.description: Refuse git add or git commit when it would stage or commit a COMMITS.md scratchpad.

warn_main_checkout_commit.title: Warn on commits in the main checkout
warn_main_checkout_commit.description: Warn when git commit runs in a repo's main checkout while linked worktrees exist.

require_subagent_model.title: Require a model on subagent calls
require_subagent_model.description: Refuse an Agent call to a built-in agent type that runs on this session's model (general-purpose, claude, Explore, Plan) when it names no model. A managed, project or user agent that reuses one of those names decides with its own model; other agents are left to their own definitions.

email_greeting.title: Greet by the time of day in email drafts
email_greeting.description: Refuse an epistole or Gmail connector draft, send or reply whose body does not open with Good morning, Good afternoon or Good evening for the local time (morning before 12:00, afternoon until 17:00, evening after), or opens with Hi, Hello, Hey or Dear. A first line in another language passes.

email_timezone.title: Email greeting: time zone
email_timezone.description: The IANA time zone email_greeting reads the clock in, such as America/New_York. Empty means this machine's local time.

restart_on_update.title: Restart idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code
restart_on_update.description: When Claude Code has updated on disk and this session is idle, open a new tmux window or Windows Terminal tab (WSL) that stops this session and resumes it on the new version. Any key during the 15 second countdown there cancels it.

budget_mode.title: Budget mode: cheaper models when the allowance burns too fast
budget_mode.description: Read the 5-hour and 7-day usage your status line saves (see /phylax:setup) and, when it runs ahead of the time gone, tell background sessions, and interactive ones that opt in with PHYLAX_BUDGET=on, to route work to Sonnet and Haiku; in frugal, run an Agent call that names Opus, Fable or best on Sonnet unless its description says final review.

budget_lean_pace.title: Budget: lean at this many points ahead of pace
budget_lean_pace.description: Lean when a window's used percent minus the percent of it already gone reaches this.

budget_lean_used.title: Budget: lean at this percent used
budget_lean_used.description: Lean when a window reaches this percent used, whatever the pace.

budget_frugal_pace.title: Budget: frugal at this many points ahead of pace
budget_frugal_pace.description: Frugal when a window's used percent minus the percent of it already gone reaches this.

budget_frugal_used.title: Budget: frugal at this percent used
budget_frugal_used.description: Frugal when a window reaches this percent used, whatever the pace.

budget_state_file.title: Budget: usage snapshot file
budget_state_file.description: Where budget mode reads the saved usage. Empty means phylax-budget.json in this account's Claude config folder, where the status line step writes by default.
